free.question: Is Acadence free?
free.answer: Yes. The Free plan is free with no time limit, and signing up doesn't require a credit card. Pro and Plus are optional monthly upgrades that add Aven AI.

freeIncludes.question: What's included in the Free plan?
freeIncludes.answer: The complete learning workspace: subjects and topics, the study timer, the study planner with recurring sessions, goals, milestones and tasks, study analytics, and the resource library for files, notes, videos and links. Aven AI is not included.

aven.question: What can Aven AI do?
aven.answer: Aven can talk through your goals and progress, propose goals broken into milestones and tasks, suggest study sessions that fit your schedule, and send reminders about upcoming sessions and deadlines. Aven works from what you record in Acadence—it can't see what you do outside the app.

proVsPlus.question: What's the difference between Pro and Plus?
proVsPlus.answer: Both include Aven AI. Plus has a higher monthly AI usage allowance, more proactive check-ins, adaptive recovery planning when you fall behind, personalized weekly reviews and advanced goal coaching.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.answer: Yes. You can move between plans from Billing in your account settings. A paid plan starts only after our payment provider confirms your payment.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
cancel.answer: Yes, anytime. Cancelling stops future renewals. You keep your paid features until the end of the period you've already paid for, then your account moves to Free. Your subjects, goals and study history are kept.

mobile.question: Does Acadence work on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. Acadence runs in the browser on phones, tablets and computers, with a layout designed for small screens. There's no separate app to install.

withoutAi.question: Can I use Acadence without AI?
withoutAi.answer: Absolutely. Every core feature works without Aven, and the Free plan has no AI at all. On paid plans, Aven stays off until you choose to turn it on.

data.question: How is my learning data handled?
data.answer: Your notes and files are private to your account. Aven only processes your learning data after you enable it, and reading your resource content requires a separate permission. You can export your data or delete your account from Settings.

autoChange.question: Can Aven automatically change my study schedule?
autoChange.answer: No. Aven proposes changes—like new study sessions or a catch-up plan—and nothing is applied until you review and approve it.
